extensionName.description: Extension name shown in chrome://extensions and the Chrome Web Store listing.

extensionDescription.message: Bulk export photos (and optionally videos) from your Strava activities into a single zip. Runs locally in your browser.
extensionDescription.description: Short blurb shown in the Chrome Web Store listing. Stay under 132 characters.

selectAllVisible.description: Label for the checkbox that toggles all photo-bearing rows on the current page.

includeVideos.description: Label for the checkbox that decides whether videos are bundled alongside photos. Off by default.

downloadSelected.description: Primary action button. Disabled until at least one row with photos is selected.

selectedCount.description: Status text showing how many rows are currently selected.

photoButton.description: Label on the per-row button that downloads photos for a single activity.

photoButtonTitle.description: Tooltip on the per-row photo download button.

preparingDownloads.description: Brief status shown immediately after the user clicks Download photos.

downloadingProgress.description: Progress shown while a photos-only bulk download is in flight.

downloadingProgressMedia.description: Progress shown when the run includes both photos and videos.

buildingZip.description: Final stage of a bulk download - photos are fetched, now JSZip is assembling them.

savedPhotos.description: Terminal success message after a photos-only run.

savedMedia.message: Saved $PHOTOS$ photos and $VIDEOS$ videos from $ACTIVITIES$ activities.
savedMedia.description: Terminal success message when a run includes both photos and videos.

savedWithSkips.description: Terminal partial-success message. REASON is the first failure reason verbatim. REASON may stay in English.

noPhotosFound.message: No photos found in the selected activities.
noPhotosFound.description: Terminal message when the user kicks off a photos-only run but no selected activity has photos.

noMediaFound.message: No photos or videos found in the selected activities.
noMediaFound.description: Terminal message when the user kicks off a run with Include videos checked but no selected activity has any media.

downloadFailed.description: Terminal error message when an entire bulk run fails.

cancel.description: Label on the cancel button that appears next to the bulk button while a run is in flight.

cancelled.description: Terminal status when the user cancels a bulk run via the Cancel button.

koFiTitle.message: Buy Me a Coffee at ko-fi.com
koFiTitle.description: Hover tooltip on the Ko-fi support button in the toolbar. Keep 'Ko-fi' as a proper noun.
